body.name: Cert
body.def: \(\mathfrak C=(q^+,\mathcal E_n,\mathcal P_t,\mathcal P_h,\mathcal P_V,\mathcal P_z,\mathcal I_G,\mathcal I_\phi,L_{\mathrm{CDF}},B_\gamma^+,\mathsf{branch})\), where \(q^+\), \(B_\gamma^+\), and every partition endpoint are rational, \(L_{\mathrm{CDF}}\) is a rational lower bound, and \(\mathsf{branch}\in\{\mathsf{refined},\mathsf{fallback}\}\)
body.role: portable certificate verified by rational inequalities and directed interval enclosures
